pages.title: A Google Sheet as cards
pages.intro: The cards below are rows of a public Google Sheet. Edit a cell in the sheet and this page shows the change on the next load.

pages.title: An RSS feed as cards
pages.intro: The latest articles of The New York Times RSS feed, shown as cards and kept up to date.

pages.intro: The latest videos of the NASA Goddard YouTube channel, read from its public feed. A click plays the video.
